_note: Editorial translations of the two hand-added index-0 mechanic lines that have no game string (the game's Boss_hum_<n>_<k>_des keys start at 2). `{name}` is replaced with the boss name of the same culture. Everything else comes from the game's own localization (scripts/lib/fce-localization.cjs).
